metric_definitions.wall_seconds: Report primary wall time: finite GNU-time elapsed seconds; fallback valid UTC finish-start interval; fallback unchanged runner monotonic seconds. See wall_time_source.
metric_definitions.gnu_time.max_single_process_rss_kib: GNU time maximum resident set size in KiB; largest individual process, not summed scatter-worker RAM.
metric_definitions.memory.peak_descendant_rss_bytes: Maximum sampled sum of RSS of GNU time wrapper plus visible descendants; shared pages may be counted more than once.
metric_definitions.memory.peak_descendant_pss_bytes: Maximum sampled sum of PSS at samples where every observed process supplied PSS; excludes unmapped filesystem cache and kernel memory.
metric_definitions.memory.sample_interval_seconds: Target polling interval; short-lived processes/brief memory spikes can be missed. Actual timestamps are retained.
metric_definitions.process_class_summary: Argv-inferred phases. Active seconds sum polling intervals with a phase observed; phases overlap and are not exact stage wall times or additive.
metric_definitions.process_events: Observed PID/create-time identities, argv, first/last observations and per-process sampled memory peaks; unobserved short-lived processes are absent.
metric_definitions.expected_min_edges: Minimum nonempty noncomment line count of first expected file; not ground-truth accuracy.
metric_definitions.utc_interval_seconds: UTC finished_utc minus started_utc when valid and nonnegative.
